title: the proof of the table: a name is a name and not a call, and a tick in data is no place
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track A (the wave A3) for the fourth time: the discriminator of the package of the waves 87 to 89 named one finding that touches it (F23), and the review of the wave found three classes of escape of the same family beside it.  The code of the kernel is honest; the proof was not.  The wave touches no code of the kernel.  (1) **A name in a quoted list counted as a call** (F23): the walk of the calls went into the operands of a `quote', and the head of the quoted list became a call -- so a definition that only a quoted list named was a root of the runtime, and the move inside it was a move of the runtime.  The doctrine of the check says the opposite -- a name is not a call -- and the code of the walk said otherwise.  (2) **A name in a list of names counted as a call**: the names of the bindings of a `let', the variable of the spec of a `dolist', the pattern of a `pcase' and the types of the handlers of a `condition-case' are names and not code; the runtime reads them and does not run them.  (3) **A tick in a quoted form counted as a place**: the runtime does not run a quoted form, so a tick that stood in one witnessed nothing at all; the parts that are unquoted in a `backquote' are the only code of it.  (4) **The name of a type and the names of the slots counted as calls**: the description of a `cl-defstruct' is a list of names, and the name of a derived mode is a name as well.  The class of the family is one, and the wave closes all four: a name in a position where a name stands calls nothing, and a definition that only such a list names is dead for the runtime.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about the runtime: the walk reads the **words of the code** of the kernel and not the trace of the runtime.  The price is named and it is three prices.  (a) The walk reads the positions it knows, and a position it does not know is read as a call: **the kernel does hold such positions** -- 55 `when-let', `if-let' and `*when-let' and 3 `cl-labels' -- and the walk of this wave did not know them, so the kernel of 2026-11-20 and the proof of this wave disagreed; the wave 93 repairs that: the walk learns the positions of every macro and every special form that the kernel uses, and a form that the walk does not know is a defect of its own, which the check names by its file and its line.  The positions of the family that the kernel does not hold are named in the file of the check -- the keys of the clauses of a `case' are data, the names of the bindings of a `destructuring-bind' and of a `multiple-value-bind' are names, the name of the variable of the specifier of a `cl-defmethod' is a name, and the names of the arguments of a `cl-defgeneric' are names.  **Amendment of 2026-11-21 (the wave 93):** the words of this price that the wave 90 wrote -- "the kernel holds no such position today" and the two positions that were named wrongly -- were false, as the discriminator of the package of the waves 90 to 92 showed.  (b) The first argument of a `funcall' or of an `apply' is a call **by the doctrine of the check**, and not by the code of the runtime: a name in it is a call, and the runtime calls the value there.  A call assembled on the fly (`(funcall (intern name))') is not seen.  (c) The numbers of the report are nailed to the kernel of 2026-11-20, so a wave that changes `lib/' has to change the constant of the check too; a measurement that got smaller does not pass as the same one, because a proof that rests on less is weaker.
refuted_by: a cell of the table of the machine is not a move the machine makes, or a label of the table has no live place in the runtime where a run takes that move, or a live place takes the move of a cell from a state the cell does not lead from, or the runtime takes a move the machine does not have, or the runtime takes a move whose label the check cannot read, or a place of the runtime that stands in no definition of the kernel witnesses a cell, or a name that stands in a position where a name stands is read as a call, or a tick that stands in data is read as a place of the runtime, or the runtime narrows a fan of the table whose coverage the runtime states in full, or a fan of the table does not end in one state, or a state of the machine is not reachable from the first one through the cells of the table, or the check measured the table differently than it measured it before, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `every-transition-of-the-table-is-taken' is the same, the text says that the walk of the code reads a name as a name and not as a call and that a tick in data is no place of the runtime; the `falsifier' names the new refusals, and the `control' is the same.  Twelve controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-20 -- three by the writer of the wave and nine more by the parent, and the parent's nine were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, and the numbers unchanged: 23 places of a tick, 23 of them live, 14 name the state and 9 do not, 8 of the 17 labels have no place that names the state, 15 of the 31 cells rest on a place that says nothing about the state, 2 fans, 0 places outside a definition and 0 places in a dead one.  (2) The finding F23 itself -- the tick of the nudge is moved into a definition that only a quoted list names -- the code 1, and the refusal names the cell `(post-decide nudge . deciding)' and the place that witnesses it.  (3) The same helper, but it is **called** by name -- the code 0: a live witness is still a witness.  (4) The same helper, called through `funcall' with a quoted name -- the code 0: the first argument of a `funcall' is a call by the doctrine of the check.  (5) The name of a helper named only in the bindings of a `let' -- the code 1.  (6) The control of the claim -- the code 1.  (7) **The parent's own controls of the classes that the writer named beside the finding**: a tick in a quoted form inside a **live** function -- the code 0 and the numbers unchanged, so a quoted tick is not a place; the name of a type in a `cl-defstruct' and the name of a derived mode, each with a definition of that name that nobody calls -- the code 1 in both cases, and the refusal names the class `:places-of-a-dead-definition' (expected 0, measured 1).  Before the third commit of the wave both of them were green: the description of the struct and the name of the mode were read as calls, and a dead definition looked alive.  **Amendment of 2026-11-21 (the wave 93):** the probe of the writer on 39 cases of the positions of the family is **not in the tree** -- the controls of the wave were made on copies of the tree and were not kept, and the tree holds no file of that probe -- so the wave rests on the controls that are named above and on the probe of the discriminator of the package of the waves 90 to 92, which was built independently and found the positions that the walk of this wave did not know.  The measurement of the wave: the check is 1602 lines and 78.3 kB (the wave 88 one was 1279 lines and 61.3 kB); the file of the kernel was not touched by this wave, and the branch holds three commits.
